title: licence-activate-request
description: POST /api/v1/licence/activate body (section 17.15) - sent by ANY till when the shop pastes the e-mailed key. No branch key needed: the licence key is the credential.

deviceName.description: Windows PC name, for the portal's device list.

approverKids.description: Built-in kids whose signer certificates this till accepts (docs/web-portal-api.md 17.17). Sign a returned token with a kid in trustedKids, or with your certified key when its certificate approvedBy is in this list.

trustedKids.description: Kids this till build trusts: sign the returned token with one of them.

existingIds.description: The till's own ids. The till has usually traded on its 7-day trial before the key arrives and NEVER re-keys its data: record these ids against the licence (alias them to your company/branch if they differ).
